sources.quote: 4.3 A supplier with status conditional may not receive new parts.

findings.why: Fonderia Dora has been conditional since 2026-09-15 (replacing the 2022 approved status). No later record restores it, so it may not receive new business.

sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The statement that Dora is still on the approved list is wrong. APR-009 was superseded by APR-010, which is revoked. The current approved source for HB-620 is Fonderia Pellice (APR-011).

sources.quote: porosity grade 4 in the mount bores of HB-620 castings (AlSi9Cu3)

findings.why: Dora has an open 8D on the AlSi9Cu3 HB-620 castings, which are the part and material of this order.

sources.quote: porosity grade 4 in the mount bores of HB-620 castings (AlSi9Cu3), three escapes to the Nordhavn line
SC-HB620-POR,HB-620,Porosity grade 2 or better in mount bores,

findings.why: Dora's HB-620 castings measured porosity grade 4, which fails the special characteristic requiring grade 2 or better. The 8D is still open, so there is no corrective action on record.

sources.quote: 5.1 A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before the first shipment.

findings.why: HB-620 belongs to PRG-Y (Nordhavn), and the board agreed on 2026-09-15 to move it to Pellice. Going back to Dora is another change of source, so Nordhavn approval is needed before the first shipment. No such approval is in the documents.
